termZh: 边框 - 端端 - 启动 - 辐射
definitionZh: 边框-end-start-radius CSS属性定义了元素上的逻辑边框半径,根据元素的写法模式,方向和文字导向,将边框映射到物理边框半径. 这在构建样式以工作时是有用的,不管文字方向和写法模式如何.
sourceDefinition: The border-end-start-radius CSS property defines a logical border radius on an element, which maps to a physical border radius depending on the element's writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation. This is useful when building styles to work regardless of the text orientation and writing mode.
